title: Removing Keyboard leaves the wrong cart line
description: Removing one product appears to retain it and discard the other product.

report.expected: Only Mouse Pad should remain in the cart.
report.actual: Keyboard remains and Mouse Pad disappears.
report.context: Fresh browser storage and an empty cart.

preconditions: Two products are present in the product list.
steps: 1. Navigate to the product list page.
2. Verify that two products are displayed.
3. Click the remove/delete button for one of the products.
reproduction.expected: The selected product should be removed from the list, while the other product remains visible.
reproduction.actual: The selected product remains in the list and the other product disappears.
